name: verify-existing-object
purpose: Verify one existing object through a compiled read-only route with no success-path Agent decision and no confirmatory reread.
preconditions: The outer workflow validated exact STP scope and bound one authenticated Fiori session.
Every operation is READ and every input has current-run provenance.
The compiled plan contains one exact app target, search binding, read-only detail target, and explicit assertions.

stop_conditions.success: The unique exact object's declared assertions are evaluated and required Evidence is saved.
stop_conditions.failure: The first zero/many candidate, unsafe route, identity conflict, SAP Error, missing element, timeout, or failed assertion is returned.
stop_conditions.terminal_rule: On EXECUTION_COMPLETE, FAILED, BLOCKED, or NEED_DECISION, return to the parent immediately without further browser reads.

retry.read_actions: No routine retry. Allow one diagnostic recovery only after a technical failure proves no effect occurred.
retry.mutation_actions: Not applicable; this workflow cannot cross a mutation boundary.

exceptions.multiple_candidates: Return NEED_DECISION with identities from the existing result observation.
exceptions.unknown_message: Escalate only when the message blocks progress or contradicts an assertion.
